paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
15. The role played by middle management is diminishing as the tasks performed
by them are increasingly being replaced by new and improved technological
tools. As a result, in a three layer organizational structure, middle level is
constricted.
Which one of the following is a suitable name to such structure?
(A) Hourglass structure
(B) Network Structure
(C) Matrix structure
(D) Divisional structure
